name: Natsunagi Touya
source: A first-year at Kakyouin High School and the team's relationer. A kind, friendly boy who has a hobby of making handmade mascots. Despite being from rival schools, he bonds quickly with [url=/c35847]Nana[/url] because of their shared love for mascot characters.
